meta.title: Frankencoin for savers: retail and crypto-native
meta.description: Save in Swiss francs at the protocol rate, by bank transfer or from crypto. Live figures, the dollar comparison and three steps.

hero.title: A Swiss-franc account|that lives on-chain.
hero.subtitle: Whether you start from a bank account or a crypto wallet, ZCHF earns the protocol rate and stays yours.

items.title: From your bank account

items.title: From USDC, USDT or ETH
items.description: Swap into ZCHF on CoW Swap, Curve or Uniswap. Save at the protocol rate, or hold FCS for exposure to protocol income.
